sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: dark meat stays flavorful and forgiving to cook. That makes chicken thigh easier to use well in real meals than drier leaner cuts. Usually a reasonably affordable whole-food protein. Chicken thigh is often cheaper than premium animal proteins while still providing a substantial protein serving. Easy to build complete meals around. It works as an actual centrepiece protein rather than a garnish ingredient.
